report:
Reviewed the complete crates.sage_ir.types.body.await claim and all fresh supplied associations. The claim requires a high-level await operation with explicitly resolved IntoFuture conversion and Future::Output type, and excludes polling, suspension-point lowering, and state-machine lowering. Captured typed-ir-guide.md, the accepted architectural-foundations completed-body rationale, and the current await checker branch as additional review dependencies.

The only implementation association is the explicit sage_meta::todo marker in crates/sage-meta/tests/representation_spec.rs: Await conversion/output elaboration remains pending. The only associated test, sage_meta::todo::types_body_await, contains the same TODO and no executable assertion. Thus neither association asserts implemented semantics or meaningful behavioral coverage. There are no ordinary or N/A evidence entries to credit.

The current check/expr.rs await branch checks its operand, introduces a fresh type variable, and constructs TyExprData::Await(ri). This confirms the described elaboration prerequisite: that branch does not resolve an IntoFuture conversion or compute Future::Output. Its syntactic high-level node alone is insufficient evidence for the claimed resolved high-level operation. The design guide explicitly describes the destination as a resolved conversion/output node without generator machinery; the accepted RFD places completed typed trees above coroutine state-machine layout. These design descriptions are not tests.

The explicit deferral accounts for the whole claim. To replace it, implementation and associated tests must establish the selected conversion identity and substitutions, the resolved Future::Output result, and the retained high-level await node, with tree assertions excluding polling, suspension-point and state-machine lowering. Existing placeholder execution would not establish any of these properties. Lack of an await elaboration implementation justifies retaining this TODO; it does not justify treating the absence of low-level lowering in this isolated branch as complete coverage. No claim was weakened and no partial implementation was promoted to ordinary evidence.

Performed source inspection using review start/read and recorded captured dependencies. No behavioral tests or source changes were performed in this review; centrally run suites remain separate execution evidence. No edits requested because the implementation and test gaps are already explicit and correctly deferred.
